longBusinessSummary: Anthropic is an AI research firm, focusing on enhancing the safety and functionality of AI systems. The company's expertise extends across various domains, including natural language processing, human feedback and code generation. Their flagship product, Claude, has the ability to handle complex, voluminous text data, opening up new possibilities for in-depth analysis and decision-making support.
